repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Heparin Cofactor 2（HC-II）為絲胺酸蛋白酶抑制劑，抑制凝血酶活性；Galcanezumab 作用於 CGRP 神經肽路徑，兩者無已知生物學交集。TxGNN 超高分（0.9950）疑為知識圖譜中共享節點（血管調節相關）導致的假性高分。
抗凝血酶（Antithrombin）缺乏導致血栓形成傾向，屬凝血瀑布調控障礙；Galcanezumab 為 CGRP 拮抗劑，主要影響神經血管調控，對凝血因子活性無直接調節機制。
Factor V 過量導致自發性血栓屬凝血因子功能增益性缺陷；CGRP 拮抗作用無法影響 Factor V 活性或凝血酶生成，機轉不相符。
CGRP 具輕度血管擴張效應，理論上可能間接影響血流剪切力，但此效應極弱且方向不確定；Galcanezumab 阻斷 CGRP 後對血栓形成風險的影響方向甚至可能為負面。無任何臨床或前臨床證據支持此適應症。

literature.title: Effect of galcanezumab on severity and symptoms of migraine in phase 3 trials in patients with episodic or chronic migraine.
literature.journal: The journal of headache and pain
literature.abstract: Galcanezumab, a humanized monoclonal antibody that binds calcitonin gene-related peptide, has demonstrated a significant reduction in monthly migraine headache days compared with placebo. Here, we analyze data from 3 randomized clinical trials (2 episodic trials [EVOLVE-1, EVOLVE-2] and 1 chronic trial [REGAIN]), to examine if galcanezumab also alleviates the severity and symptoms of migraine.

literature.abstract: The goal of this observational, open-label, cohort study was to determine whether prophylactic migraine treatment with galcanezumab, a peripherally acting drug, alters the incidence of premonitory symptoms, and/or occurrence of headache after exposure to triggers or aura episodes in treatment-responders (≥ 50% reduction in monthly migraine days [MMD]), super-responders (≥ 70%), non-responders (< 50%) and super non-responders (< 30%).

literature.abstract: The total burden of migraine includes not only the episodes with headache pain but extends throughout the interictal periods. Interictal symptoms and associated psychological responses may profoundly impact well-being and drive treatment-seeking behavior.

literature.abstract: Calcitonin gene-related peptide monoclonal antibodies (CGRP mAbs) are effective in clinical trials and real-world settings. literature.title: Effectiveness and safety of anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies in hemiplegic migraine: an individual patient quantitative analysis.
literature.journal: The journal of headache and pain
literature.abstract: Hemiplegic migraine (HM) is a rare and disabling subtype of migraine with aura characterized by reversible motor weakness. Preventive treatment remains challenging, as patients with HM are systematically excluded from RCTs. Monoclonal antibodies targeting the calcitonin gene-related peptide pathway (anti-CGRP mAbs) have shown effectiveness in migraine with typical aura, but evidence in HM is limited.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Galcanezumab 阻斷 CGRP 與其受體結合，而 CGRP 在所有偏頭痛亞型（含腦幹先兆型）的發作期均顯著升高，機轉一致性強。腦幹先兆型偏頭痛雖曾被 Triptan 類藥物列為相對禁忌（因血管收縮顧慮），但 anti-CGRP mAb 不具血管收縮效應，理論安全性優於 Triptan。
Atrophoderma vermiculata 為毛囊性萎縮性皮膚病，病理機制涉及毛囊角化異常；CGRP 在皮膚感覺神經末梢有分布並參與皮膚神經源性炎症，但 Galcanezumab 系統性阻斷 CGRP 是否對此罕見皮膚病有療效，完全無臨床依據。
Ulerythema ophryogenesis（眉部毛周角化萎縮）為毛囊萎縮性罕見皮膚病，病因不明，可能涉及 Ras-MAPK 信號通路；與 CGRP/抗 CGRP 機轉無明確關聯。
新生兒出血病（維生素 K 缺乏性出血）為維生素 K 依賴性凝血因子缺乏所致；Galcanezumab 為 CGRP 單株抗體，對維生素 K 路徑無任何作用，且新生兒族群使用大分子生物製劑存在極高安全顧慮。
Prekallikrein（激肽釋放酶原）為接觸活化凝血路徑成員，與緩激肽（Bradykinin）生成相關；CGRP 與 Bradykinin 在神經源性炎症中共享部分下游效應，存在極遠端生物學聯結，但 Galcanezumab 阻斷 CGRP 對 prekallikrein 缺乏症無任何已知補償機制。
